clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Orgrimmar, the Scourge has raised a camp beneath a floating necropolis. Lieutenant Dagel calls on defenders to repel the undead, recover necrotic stones, and examine runic circles charged with necromantic energy. The attack brings the Lich King's reach to Durotar.

The Scourge now threatens lands far from Lordaeron and the northern ice. Floating necropolises cast their shadows across Azeroth, even over Durotar. Undead forces have gathered at Orgrimmar's threshold, raising camps that threaten the Horde capital. Lieutenant Dagel and the Argent Dawn coordinate the defense, calling on local champions to drive the invaders back before they can secure a siege.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Orgrimmar from these accursed invaders?

There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... They must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
